offering_description.value: The company transports finished vehicles for automakers, dealerships, auctions, rental and leasing fleets, and individual customers. It coordinates shipments through integrated route planning, dispatch, and real-time tracking. Its dedicated repair facilities maintain its own fleet and service external fleets.

quotes.quote: PAL specializes in new vehicle delivery to dealerships, but we’re built to handle much more. We serve OEMs, EV makers, dealers, auctions, rental fleets, and leasing providers with full-spectrum transport services. And with dedicated repair facilities operated by Proficient Repair Services, we keep our fleet running reliably—and support external fleets—to meet transport needs of any size or complexity.

Proficient Auto Logistics provides efficient vehicle transport services for individuals, businesses, and fleet operators throughout the United States and Canada. With integrated route planning, real-time tracking, and dispatch, every delivery is executed with security, precision, and timeliness.
